environment_constraints: NEVER touch src/app/(payload)/ — it is Payload-managed. NEVER replace buildFigmaConfig with buildConfig in src/payload.config.ts. NEVER run pnpm install. contribution_requirements: Use buildFigmaConfig in payload.config.ts (already there). Keep ecoCertCollections spread. Do not modify src/app/(payload)/. overrideAccess: false on all user-facing Local API calls. Server Actions must have 'use server' at file top. Client Components have 'use client'. When a Client Component calls a Server Action inside useTransition, keep revalidatePath out of the action — return serializable result and call router.refresh() on client side after success.
key_patterns: Collections: defined in src/collections/EcoCert.ts, exported as named constants + ecoCertCollections array. Access: appAccess const (create/delete/read/update: isAppUser) reused across all app collections. organizationField const reused as first field in every collection. payload.config.ts imports ecoCertCollections and spreads it — adding to ecoCertCollections array is sufficient to register. Server Actions: 'use server', getPayload({ config }), overrideAccess: false, return { success, data?, error? }. getCurrentUser uses cookies() + payload.auth({ headers }). EcoCertApp.tsx: single 'use client' SPA, ~1350 lines, all pages inside one file. useMemo drives page rendering. Static data arrays need to be replaced with useEffect + server action calls.
